title: Everyone pays Swiss VAT
hints: Build calculators for two regions with very different rates and call both. Which rate does every calculator end up using?
`with_tax` reads `rate` when it's **called**, not when it's defined. By then the loop has finished and `rate` holds the last region's value, so every calculator shares it.
Capture the current value when the function is created, with a default parameter: `def with_tax(net_cents: int, rate: float = rate) -> int:`.
